scenarios.title: A cast spell moves to the stack and resolves unless something stops it

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests; Grizzly Bears moves from A's hand to the stack.
Both players pass; Grizzly Bears resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes from A's hand to the stack and then resolves onto A's battlefield. A's Forests are tapped. B's Counterspell is still in B's hand.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: Instead of passing, B responds by casting Counterspell targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is on the stack when Counterspell resolves and is countered: it moves to A's graveyard without reaching the battlefield. A's Forests stay tapped.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B casts Counterspell instead of passing

detector.outcome: A cast spell leaves the stack as resolved.

scenarios.title: A spell can be cast only if its costs can be paid

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: The engine is asked whether A, holding priority in main1 with an empty stack, can cast Grizzly Bears from hand.

variants.label: payable
variants.expected: Legal: can_play is true, because {1}{G} can be paid with the two untapped Forests.

variants.label: unpayable
variants.delta: One of A's Forests is tapped.
variants.expected: Not legal: can_play is false, because {1}{G} cannot be paid with one untapped Forest.

detector.outcome: A spell candidate whose costs can be paid is affordable.
detector.near_miss: A spell candidate whose costs cannot be paid.
